title: Sparkly banana
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF9C4" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFF9C4" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- banana body -->
  <path d="M 30 25 C 22 40, 25 65, 45 78 C 60 88, 78 85, 85 72 C 88 66, 87 60, 82 58 C 78 57, 74 60, 73 65 C 69 75, 58 78, 48 73 C 36 67, 32 50, 38 35 C 40 30, 40 25, 36 22 Z"
        fill="#FFD93D" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- banana highlight -->
  <path d="M 38 32 C 33 45, 36 60, 46 67 C 50 70, 55 71, 58 69"
        fill="none" stroke="#FFF176" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- banana tip -->
  <path d="M 30 25 C 28 22, 29 19, 33 18 C 37 17, 39 20, 37 22 Z"
        fill="#8D6E63"/>

  <!-- banana stem -->
  <path d="M 82 58 C 85 55, 89 54, 92 57 C 94 60, 92 63, 89 63 C 86 63, 84 61, 82 58 Z"
        fill="#6D4C41"/>

  <!-- sparkle 1 - top left -->
  <g transform="translate(18,15)">
    <path d="M 0 -6 L 1.5 -1.5 L 6 0 L 1.5 1.5 L 0 6 L -1.5 1.5 L -6 0 L -1.5 -1.5 Z"
          fill="#FFF176"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 2 - top right -->
  <g transform="translate(78,20)">
    <path d="M 0 -5 L 1.2 -1.2 L 5 0 L 1.2 1.2 L 0 5 L -1.2 1.2 L -5 0 L -1.2 -1.2 Z"
          fill="#FFEE58"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 3 - right -->
  <g transform="translate(90,45)">
    <path d="M 0 -7 L 1.8 -1.8 L 7 0 L 1.8 1.8 L 0 7 L -1.8 1.8 L -7 0 L -1.8 -1.8 Z"
          fill="#FFF59D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 4 - bottom -->
  <g transform="translate(65,92)">
    <path d="M 0 -5 L 1.2 -1.2 L 5 0 L 1.2 1.2 L 0 5 L -1.2 1.2 L -5 0 L -1.2 -1.2 Z"
          fill="#FFF176"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 5 - left -->
  <g transform="translate(12,55)">
    <path d="M 0 -4 L 1 -1 L 4 0 L 1 1 L 0 4 L -1 1 L -4 0 L -1 -1 Z"
          fill="#FFEE58"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 6 - bottom left small -->
  <g transform="translate(28,85)">
    <path d="M 0 -3.5 L 0.9 -0.9 L 3.5 0 L 0.9 0.9 L 0 3.5 L -0.9 0.9 L -3.5 0 L -0.9 -0.9 Z"
          fill="#FFF59D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 7 - tiny accent -->
  <g transform="translate(85,82)">
    <path d="M 0 -3 L 0.8 -0.8 L 3 0 L 0.8 0.8 L 0 3 L -0.8 0.8 L -3 0 L -0.8 -0.8 Z"
          fill="#FFD54F"/>
  </g>
</svg>
